recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆遠大於周圍細胞的巨大細胞，只有一個分葉狀摺疊的大核，周圍是豐富的細顆粒狀淡紫色細胞質、外緣偏藍，這就是成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Single large lobulated, folded nucleus with coarse but open chromatin and no separate nuclei
Abundant finely granular pinkish-lilac cytoplasm with a bluish, slightly fringed peripheral zone
Surrounding erythroid precursors and lymphocytes; a few cells closely abutting the megakaryocyte
Background red cells forming a thick smear area
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with a single lobulated, folded nucleus and abundant finely granular pink-lilac cytoplasm with a bluish peripheral zone, surrounded by erythroid precursors and lymphocytes. The nuclear lobation and cytoplasmic granularity are appropriate for a mature, platelet-producing megakaryocyte, without hypolobation, separated nuclear lobes or micromegakaryocytic features. Findings are consistent with a normal-appearing megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, round, uniform nuclei with fine chromatin and coarse azurophilic granules rather than a single lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms are small or hypolobated with round, monolobated or widely separated nuclei, unlike the normally lobulated nucleus here.
Megakaryoblasts are much smaller with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm with blebs.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or Reed-Sternberg-like cell
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show prominent nucleoli and cohesive clusters, and lack the granular platelet-producing cytoplasm of megakaryocytes.
